title: Caramel Rum Bananas Foster Skillet
hookLine: Caramelized brown-butter bananas bubbling in cinnamon sauce over cold vanilla bean ice cream.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {ban_bf} and {bsug_bf} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Sizzle Bananas in Brown Butter Caramel
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {bsug_bf} in a wide skillet until bubbling caramel, lay {ban_bf} cut-side down 2 mins per side until glossy, and spoon hot over {ice_bf}.
steps.creatorSecret: Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

steps.title: Bake Caramel Rum Bananas Foster Skillet & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 6 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Caramel Rum Bananas Foster Skillet to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 11 mins.
